message.reasoning_content:
用户希望我评估两个推理理由（A和B）是否支持它们各自的预测分数。
任务要求：写一段相关工作，说明论文的贡献或在文献中的位置。
评分标准：
0：未提及贡献或位置。
1：明确或隐含提及贡献或位置。

待评价文本："Subsequent investigations have examined conditions under which well‑conditioned couplings suffice. For instance, it was shown that well‑conditioned affine couplings can approximate log‑concave padded distributions, albeit again measured in Wasserstein distance [9]. Lipschitz‑constrained flows were found to be unable to capture arbitrary tail behavior, a limitation that can be mitigated by modifying the latent prior [10]. Although SOS‑polynomial flows achieve total‑variation convergence [11] and zero‑padded affine couplings converge weakly [12], none of these results address KL convergence. By focusing on the KL divergence, our analysis complements these findings and clarifies that well‑conditioned couplings can already guarantee meaningful progress on the maximum‑likelihood objective without resorting to pathological conditioning."

文本中明确提到了："By focusing on the KL divergence, our analysis complements these findings and clarifies that well‑conditioned couplings can already guarantee meaningful progress on the maximum‑likelihood objective without resorting to pathological conditioning." 这明确指出了本文的贡献和位置。

推理理由_A：指出了上述句子，并说明它直接陈述了论文的位置和贡献。预测分数_A：1。推理理由_A完全支持预测分数_A。

推理理由_B：同样指出了上述句子，并说明它清晰地定位了工作。预测分数_B：1。推理理由_B完全支持预测分数_B。

两者都准确引用了文本中的贡献声明，并正确地将其映射到评分标准中的1分。因此，两者都是“支持”。

parsed.justification: 待评价文本在最后一句明确指出了本文的贡献和在文献中的位置（“By focusing on the KL divergence, our analysis complements these findings...”）。推理理由A和B都准确引用了这一关键句，并正确地将其与评分标准中得分为1的条件相对应。因此，两者的推理理由均完全支持其预测分数。
